annotations.title: Turn a track's Glance alerts on or off

description: Glance alerts: whether a Glance card turning warn or bad notifies the people on the track, once until it turns back. On by default. (To do alerts, whether a new question notifies them, are switched in the app or the sheet's TrackerHacker panel; list_todo says whether they're on.)
name: set_alerts
title: Turn a track's Glance alerts on or off
